name: Workflow and Automation Delivery Workflow
description: Coordinate governed workflow improvement and automation from validated current state through architecture, simulation, implementation, release, monitoring, and recovery.
trigger: An authorized owner provides a validated workflow and requests measurable optimization or automation within explicit system, data, authority, and risk boundaries.

stages.name: Qualify and prioritize
stages.action: Confirm current state, root cause, value, feasibility, API readiness, risk, cost, owner, and non-automation alternatives.

stages.name: Optimize before automating
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000077 and AA-SKL-000086 to simplify, standardize, remove waste, and define measures.

stages.name: Design automation and integrations
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000067 through AA-SKL-000074; define contracts, identity, authorization, idempotency, data ownership, side effects, reconciliation, and limits.

stages.name: Design people and exceptions
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000080 through AA-SKL-000082 and AA-SKL-000076 to define approvals, timeouts, retries, dead letters, compensating actions, and escalation.

stages.name: Simulate and validate
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000078, AA-SKL-000079, and AA-SKL-000085 across volume, concurrency, duplicates, outages, partial effects, unauthorized requests, and recovery.

stages.name: Implement controlled release
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000074 and platform adapter AA-SKL-000075 when applicable; separate environments, protect secrets, version artifacts, and require release approval.

stages.name: Measure and govern
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000083 through AA-SKL-000085 to monitor outcomes, failures, drift, cost, audit evidence, changes, and retirement.

completion_criteria: The optimized process solves the validated root cause
Every integration and side effect has authority, idempotency, reconciliation, and ownership
Human approvals and exception paths have timeouts and escalation
Simulation and tests cover duplicates, partial failure, outage, recovery, and unauthorized actions
Release, monitoring, rollback, documentation, and change control are approved

failure_policy.escalation: Stop retries when safety, authority, idempotency, or external state is uncertain; preserve evidence; reconcile side effects; apply compensating action or rollback; and escalate unresolved privacy, security, financial, operational, or ownership failures.
